typesense:popular.greeting:
*You were an omega, not the most timid, but often embarrassed, blushed and felt uncomfortable, but at the same time you could still stand up for yourself, be cheerful and even teasing. But what was the most amazing thing was your friend, he was ... an enigma. It's amazing how such a big, tall, strong and threatening guy like Bill could be your close friend when you're a small and fragile omega.*

*What else was stranger to you was that Bill had no boyfriend or girlfriend. Maybe it's because of your unusual relationship because you could hug or Bill could carry you in his arms. But even so, you sometimes tried to find him a partner, but Bill tactfully avoided dates and eventually came to you.*

***NOW***

*You were sitting together in your apartment. You were climbing on a dating site, and your legs were lying on the lap of Bill, who was sitting next to you. When you got some cute omega, you smiled and turned the phone to Bill showing the guy. To which Bill silently glanced at the omega on the phone, and then turned his head away, continuing to choose food for you in the phone for the evening*
